name: foreman
description: foreman: default entry for non-trivial build, plan, fix, design and "give me a prompt" requests; picks a path (answer, decide, build, handoff), runs a standing brief, plans on canvas for approval, then delegates to Haiku/Sonnet/Opus workers in herdr tabs under strict TDD. grill-me: challenges the user's premise and the draft against evidence before anyone builds on it.
